name: Vespid Dynamics Thermal Decoy Beacon TDB-3
product_name: Vespid Dynamics Thermal Decoy Beacon TDB-3
description: A small device that generates a thermal signature mimicking a human body, drawing the attention of thermal imaging systems and heat-seeking autonomous weapons away from real targets. The TDB-3 produces a 37°C heat pattern in a human-shaped profile using embedded heating elements, and can be placed on walls, floors, or furniture to create false targets. The beacon operates for 12 hours on a single charge and can be configured to simulate stationary, walking, or running thermal profiles.

specifications.effectiveness: Defeats standard thermal imaging and heat-seeking systems

story_hooks: A building assault team placed 20 TDB-3 beacons around the target structure — the defending thermal sensors showed 20 approaching hostiles when the actual team was 5 people entering from the one unmonitored approach.

TDB-3 beacons have been placed throughout a Tier 2 district to overwhelm corporate thermal surveillance with false human signatures — the system is drowning in phantom contacts and real threats are invisible.

physical_description.visual_profile: A flat, disc-shaped thermal emitter with a slightly domed top surface. The form factor resembles a sophisticated smoke detector crossed with a tactical device. Its compact, minimalist design belies its sophisticated heat-generation internals. The top features a subtle hexagonal pattern of thermal vents.
physical_description.dimensions: 15 cm diameter disc, approximately 2.5 cm thick
physical_description.weight_description: Lightweight and pocketable at 150 grams — easily deployable in multiples. Adhesive backing allows one-handed placement.
physical_description.primary_material: Aircraft-grade polymer composite housing with embedded ceramic thermal elements
physical_description.finish: Matte charcoal-gray with slight texture for grip; top surface has micro-perforated venting pattern
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray primary with accent strips of crimson-red edge banding. Vespid Dynamics branding in white sans-serif lettering.
physical_description.interface_elements: Recessed tactile button on underside (power/profile selector), single tri-color LED indicator (green/amber/red) embedded in top center, micro-USB charging port on edge shrouded by rubber gasket
distinctive_features: Hexagonal thermal vent pattern on top surface glowing faintly orange-red during operation
Adhesive backing visible around circumference — designed for single-use deployment
Subtle angular Vespid Dynamics delta-wing logo etched into edge band
Operational mode indicator: running/walking/stationary select via recessed button underneath
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: VESPID DYNAMICS stamped in white; MODEL TDB-3 serial number on backing; GLMZ manufacturing compliance stamps; warranty void if adhesive tampered
physical_description.condition_typical: Fresh units show pristine finish; deployed units still adhere firmly to walls/floors with orange glow visible around thermal vents. Field-used units may show dust accumulation on vents or slight adhesive residue.
